name: Humbert's Sword
summary: At Dun Garok, Humbert's Sword rests among the dwarves who took it from his camp. Deathguard Humbert left his post to gather firewood while scouting the stronghold.

sections.title: A Scout's Careless Moment
sections.body: Deathguard Humbert left his hidden post near Dun Garok one morning to gather firewood for boiling water. High Executor Darthalia had sent him to watch the dwarven presence there. While he was away, a dwarven patrol found his campsite and plundered his gear, including his personal blade. Now Humbert needs Horde agents to search the fortress and recover it.

sections.title: The Dwarven Trove
sections.body: Dun Garok's defenders carried Humbert's belongings behind the stronghold's barricades. Riflemen, mountaineers, and priests pass supplies around the garrison. To find the thief, the search must reach the defenders in the trenches and redoubts.

faq.answer: The sword belongs to Deathguard Humbert, a Forsaken sentry stationed in Tarren Mill and assigned to scout Dun Garok.

faq.q: How did the dwarves get Humbert's sword?
faq.answer: Humbert left his scout camp just outside Dun Garok one morning to gather firewood. While he was away, a dwarven patrol ransacked the camp and took his gear.

faq.q: Why is Humbert so desperate to get his sword back?
aliases: what happens if humbert loses sword
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia ordered Humbert to keep watch on Dun Garok, and he needs his weapon to do so. With so many dwarves in the garrison, he cannot find the thief alone.

faq.q: Where can the sword be found?
faq.answer: The sword is with the dwarven forces at Dun Garok in southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. It can be recovered from the mountaineers, riflemen, or priests stationed throughout the post.

angles.text: High Executor Darthalia keeps strict discipline over the Forsaken forces in Hillsbrad. Sentries like Humbert are desperate to hide their mistakes when they grow careless.
Recovering the sword supports the Horde's wider operations against Dun Garok's dwarven enclave. Those operations also include collecting dwarven blood and military insignias.
